before.content_en:
A large-format grey surface for modern kitchens, islands, and commercial counters where slab specification and fabrication quality matter.

Common applications include Kitchen, Island, Commercial Counter. Key advantages are Strong heat and stain performance, Supports a continuous large-slab look, Well suited to modern interiors, but suitability still depends on actual use intensity and site conditions.

Before selecting a sample or placing an order, confirm: Confirm brand series, thickness, vein direction, backing mesh, cut-outs, edge profile, support, and access route. Review the physical sample under the actual site lighting together with adjacent materials and edge details.

Care and limitations: Fabrication and transport are demanding; Edges require proper support and impact protection. Brand, thickness, slab size, pattern, and fabrication complexity vary widely and require a full specification quote.

Pairing direction: Pair with matte handleless cabinetry, dark metal, and linear lighting to emphasise the slab composition.
before.content_ms:
Permukaan kelabu berformat besar untuk dapur moden, meja pulau dan kaunter komersial yang memerlukan spesifikasi papak serta mutu fabrikasi yang tepat.

Kegunaan lazim termasuk Dapur, Meja pulau, Kaunter komersial. Kelebihan utama: Prestasi rintangan haba dan kotoran yang baik; Mewujudkan rupa permukaan papak besar yang berterusan; Sesuai untuk ruang dalaman moden. Kesesuaian tetap bergantung pada intensiti penggunaan sebenar dan keadaan tapak.

Sebelum memilih sampel atau membuat pesanan, sahkan siri jenama, ketebalan, arah urat, jaring sokongan belakang, bukaan potongan, profil tepi, sokongan dan laluan akses. Semak sampel fizikal di bawah pencahayaan sebenar di tapak bersama bahan bersebelahan dan perincian tepi.

Penjagaan dan had: Fabrikasi dan pengangkutan memerlukan pengendalian yang teliti; Bahagian tepi memerlukan sokongan serta perlindungan daripada hentakan. Jenama, ketebalan, saiz papak, corak dan kerumitan fabrikasi berbeza-beza; dapatkan sebut harga berdasarkan spesifikasi lengkap.

Cadangan padanan: Padankan dengan kabinet kusam tanpa pemegang, logam gelap dan pencahayaan linear untuk menonjolkan susunan papak.
before.content_zh:
适合现代厨房、中岛与商业柜台的大板灰色表面材料，重点在板材规格和加工质量。

常见适用方向包括厨房、中岛、商业柜台。主要优势是耐热耐污表现较好、可做大板连续视觉、适合简洁现代空间，但仍需结合实际使用强度和现场条件判断。

选样与下单前应确认：确认品牌系列、板厚、纹路方向、背网、切割开孔、边型、支撑结构与运输通道。实体样板要放在现场光线下，与相邻材料和收口方式一起检查。

维护与限制：加工和运输要求高；边角需正确支撑避免冲击。不同品牌、厚度、板幅、纹路和加工复杂度差异大，应按完整规格报价。

搭配方向：搭配无拉手哑光柜体、深色金属与线性灯光，可突出大板的整体感。

desired.content_en:
A large-format grey surface for modern kitchens, islands, and commercial counters where slab specification and fabrication quality matter.

Common applications include Kitchen, Island, Commercial Counter. Key advantages are Strong heat and stain performance, Supports a continuous large-slab look, Well suited to modern interiors, but suitability still depends on actual use intensity and site conditions.

Before selecting a sample or placing an order, confirm: Confirm brand series, thickness, vein direction, backing mesh, cut-outs, edge profile, support, and access route. Review the physical sample under the actual site lighting together with adjacent materials and edge details.

Care and limitations: Fabrication and transport are demanding; Edges require proper support and impact protection. Brand, thickness, slab size, pattern, and fabrication complexity vary widely and require a full specification quote.

Pairing direction: Pair with matte handleless cabinetry, dark metal, and linear lighting to emphasise the slab composition.

What should a grey sintered-stone countertop quotation separate?

Do not compare totals using countertop length or a concept image alone. Mark the kitchen runs, island, upstands and openings on one dimensioned plan. Ask each quotation provider to separate the four groups below and identify unmeasured or unselected items.

  • Material and measurement: confirm the actual brand series, colour code, thickness and slab size. State whether the charge is per slab, area or linear length, and how waste, vein alignment and offcuts are treated. Different units do not give directly comparable rates.
  • Fabrication drawing: list sink, hob and tap openings, edges, corners, joints and upstands. Identify who checks appliance dimensions, confirms vein direction and approves the final fabrication drawing.
  • Installation and interfaces: confirm delivery and handling, removal and disposal, cabinet levelling and support, countertop fitting and finishing separately. Identify responsibility for plumbing and electrical disconnection/reconnection and whether each item is included.
  • Before ordering: list unmeasured dimensions, unselected models and unresolved details. Ask how changes are requoted and when they are reconfirmed. An initial estimate should not serve as a fabrication instruction.

Why is the total price alone insufficient when both quotations describe grey sintered stone?

Similar colours do not establish the same material, quantity, openings or work scope. Compare both quotations against the same dimensioned plan and have missing items marked included, separately charged or awaiting confirmation. This page provides selection and enquiry guidance; it does not publish a verified universal rate or fixed-specification package. The actual amount depends on the selected product and site scope.

If cabinets and appliance connections are involved, review the kitchen renovation scope together.
desired.content_zh:
适合现代厨房、中岛与商业柜台的大板灰色表面材料，重点在板材规格和加工质量。

常见适用方向包括厨房、中岛、商业柜台。主要优势是耐热耐污表现较好、可做大板连续视觉、适合简洁现代空间，但仍需结合实际使用强度和现场条件判断。

搭配方向：搭配无拉手哑光柜体、深色金属与线性灯光，可突出大板的整体感。

灰色岩板台面报价应拆清哪些项目？

不要只用台面长度或一张效果图比较总价。先在同一份尺寸图上标出厨房台面、中岛、挡水与开孔位置，再请报价方写清下面四组内容；尚未测量或未选定的项目应单独标为待确认。

  • 板材与计量：确认实际品牌系列、色号、板厚和板幅；写清按板、面积或延米计价，以及损耗、纹路对齐和余料如何处理。不同计量方式不能直接比较单价。
  • 加工图纸：逐项列出水槽、炉具与龙头孔、边型、转角、接缝和挡水；标注由谁复核电器尺寸、确认纹路方向及批准最终加工图。
  • 安装与现场配套：分别确认运输和搬运、拆旧及清运、柜体调平与支撑、台面安装、收口，以及水电断接由谁负责、是否计入。
  • 下单前核对：把未测尺寸、待选型号和待确认节点列出，询问变更如何重新报价及何时再次确认；不要把初步估算当作加工指令。

同样是灰色岩板，为什么两份台面报价不能只比总价？

颜色接近不代表板材、用量、开孔和施工范围一致。先把两份报价放回同一张尺寸图，逐项核对上述内容，并要求缺项明确写“包含”“另计”或“待确认”。本页提供选型与询价方向，未发布可核验的统一单价或固定规格套餐，实际金额需按选定产品和现场范围确认。

若还涉及柜体与电器点位，先一起核对厨房装修范围。

before.content_en:
A warm-white, repairable surface for seamless joints, curves, and integrated basins in bathrooms and counters.

Common applications include Bathroom Vanity, Reception Counter, Light-Use Kitchen. Key advantages are Visually seamless joints, Minor scratches can be repaired, Suitable for curved fabrication, but suitability still depends on actual use intensity and site conditions.

Before selecting a sample or placing an order, confirm: Confirm brand, thickness, substrate, seams, thermoforming, integrated basin, edge profile, and support. Review the physical sample under the actual site lighting together with adjacent materials and edge details.

Care and limitations: Less scratch and heat resistant than some stone; Dark stains should be cleaned promptly. Cost depends on brand, thickness, shape, cut-outs, and integrated basins; complex curves are priced separately.

Pairing direction: Warm white pairs with light timber, soft wall colours, and rounded profiles for a less clinical interior.
before.content_ms:
Bahan permukaan pepejal putih bernada hangat yang boleh dibaiki, sesuai untuk sambungan yang kelihatan berterusan, bentuk melengkung dan singki bersepadu pada kabinet bilik air atau kaunter.

Kegunaan lazim termasuk Kabinet singki bilik air, Kaunter penyambut tetamu, Dapur dengan penggunaan ringan. Kelebihan utama: Sambungan kelihatan berterusan; Calar kecil boleh dibaiki; Sesuai untuk fabrikasi berbentuk lengkung. Kesesuaian tetap bergantung pada intensiti penggunaan sebenar dan keadaan tapak.

Sebelum memilih sampel atau membuat pesanan, sahkan jenama, ketebalan, substrat, sambungan, pembentukan haba, singki bersepadu, profil tepi dan sokongan. Semak sampel fizikal di bawah pencahayaan sebenar di tapak bersama bahan bersebelahan dan perincian tepi.

Penjagaan dan had: Rintangan calar dan haba lebih rendah berbanding sesetengah jenis batu; Kesan kotoran gelap perlu dibersihkan segera. Kos bergantung pada jenama, ketebalan, bentuk, bukaan potongan dan singki bersepadu; lengkung yang rumit dikira berasingan.

Cadangan padanan: Padankan warna putih bernada hangat dengan kayu cerah, warna dinding lembut dan profil membulat supaya ruang tidak terasa terlalu kaku.
before.content_zh:
可做无缝拼接、弧形和一体盆的暖白色表面材料，适合浴室、接待台与轻用厨房。

常见适用方向包括浴室柜、接待台、轻用厨房。主要优势是可实现视觉无缝、局部划痕可修复、适合弧形定制，但仍需结合实际使用强度和现场条件判断。

选样与下单前应确认：确认品牌、厚度、基层、拼缝、弧形加工、一体盆、边型与支撑结构。实体样板要放在现场光线下，与相邻材料和收口方式一起检查。

维护与限制：耐刮和耐高温低于部分石材；深色污渍需及时清洁。价格取决于品牌、厚度、造型、开孔和一体盆加工，复杂弧形需另行计算。

搭配方向：暖白面材适合浅木柜体、柔和墙色和圆角设计，能减少空间的硬冷感。

desired.content_en:
A warm-white, repairable surface for seamless joints, curves, and integrated basins in bathrooms and counters.

Common applications include Bathroom Vanity, Reception Counter, Light-Use Kitchen. Key advantages are Visually seamless joints, Minor scratches can be repaired, Suitable for curved fabrication, but suitability still depends on actual use intensity and site conditions.

Before selecting a sample or placing an order, confirm: Confirm brand, thickness, substrate, seams, thermoforming, integrated basin, edge profile, and support. Review the physical sample under the actual site lighting together with adjacent materials and edge details.

Care and limitations: Less scratch and heat resistant than some stone; Dark stains should be cleaned promptly. Cost depends on brand, thickness, shape, cut-outs, and integrated basins; complex curves are priced separately.

Pairing direction: Warm white pairs with light timber, soft wall colours, and rounded profiles for a less clinical interior.

How should warm-white solid-surface and basin quotations be compared?

First define whether the work is a straight countertop, curved reception counter or bathroom vanity with a basin. Even when both descriptions say warm-white solid surface, compare material, fabrication and site installation against the same dimensioned and detail drawings.

  • Material and appearance: record the actual brand series, colour code, thickness, finish and sample reference. Confirm quantity and charging units. A photograph does not replace approval of a physical sample.
  • Basin and openings: specify basin model, quantity, supplier and the proposed connection to the countertop. List tap, drainage and other openings separately. An integrated-basin label does not establish that every fitting and installation item is included.
  • Fabrication and joints: mark joints, curves, upstands, edges and support on the drawing. Ask for a feasible method based on the selected product documentation and agree how the sample and finished appearance will be checked.
  • Site scope: check delivery, removal, cabinet/substrate adjustments, countertop and basin fitting, tap and drainage connections and finishing responsibilities separately. Mark omissions separately charged or awaiting confirmation before comparing totals.

Do integrated-basin or seamless descriptions establish a fixed price covering every item?

Those labels do not define basin model, connection method, joint appearance or quotation scope. Check the countertop and basin documentation, detail drawing, sample and installation/plumbing responsibilities before confirming the amount and unresolved items. This page does not provide a confirmed universal price, stock availability or a seamless-result guarantee for every product.

For a bathroom vanity, also review the bathroom renovation scope for fittings and drainage.
desired.content_zh:
可做无缝拼接、弧形和一体盆的暖白色表面材料，适合浴室、接待台与轻用厨房。

常见适用方向包括浴室柜、接待台、轻用厨房。主要优势是可实现视觉无缝、局部划痕可修复、适合弧形定制，但仍需结合实际使用强度和现场条件判断。

选样与下单前应确认：确认品牌、厚度、基层、拼缝、弧形加工、一体盆、边型与支撑结构。实体样板要放在现场光线下，与相邻材料和收口方式一起检查。

维护与限制：耐刮和耐高温低于部分石材；深色污渍需及时清洁。价格取决于品牌、厚度、造型、开孔和一体盆加工，复杂弧形需另行计算。

搭配方向：暖白面材适合浅木柜体、柔和墙色和圆角设计，能减少空间的硬冷感。

暖白色人造实体面材与盆具报价怎样比较？

先明确是平直台面、弧形接待台，还是带盆具的浴室柜台面。即使都叫“暖白色人造石”，也应在同一张尺寸和节点图上核对板材、加工与现场安装，不能把外观相近当成配置相同。

  • 板材与外观：记录实际品牌系列、色号、板厚、表面处理和样板编号；要求说明用量及计价单位，照片不能代替实物样板确认。
  • 盆具与孔位：写明盆具型号、数量和供应方，以及它与台面采用的连接方式；分别列出龙头、排水和其他开孔，不要从“一体盆”名称推断已包含所有配件或安装。
  • 加工与接缝：在图上标出接缝、弧形位置、挡水、边型与支撑，要求按选定产品资料说明可实施做法，并确认如何检查样板和最终外观。
  • 现场范围：分别核对运输、拆旧、柜体或基层调整、台面/盆具安装、龙头与排水连接及收口责任。缺项写明另计或待确认，再比较总额。

“一体盆”或“无缝”是否代表一个包含所有工作的固定价格？

这些名称不足以确定盆具型号、连接做法、接缝效果或报价范围。请先核对盆具与台面的产品资料、节点图、样板以及安装和水电责任，再确认金额与未定项目。本页没有经确认的统一价格、库存或所有产品通用的无缝效果保证。

用于浴室柜时，可同时核对浴室装修的洁具与排水范围。

prior_fields_for_audit_only.content_en:
A warm-white, repairable surface for seamless joints, curves, and integrated basins in bathrooms and counters.

Common applications include Bathroom Vanity, Reception Counter, Light-Use Kitchen. Key advantages are Visually seamless joints, Minor scratches can be repaired, Suitable for curved fabrication, but suitability still depends on actual use intensity and site conditions.

Before selecting a sample or placing an order, confirm: Confirm brand, thickness, substrate, seams, thermoforming, integrated basin, edge profile, and support. Review the physical sample under the actual site lighting together with adjacent materials and edge details.

Care and limitations: Less scratch and heat resistant than some stone; Dark stains should be cleaned promptly. Cost depends on brand, thickness, shape, cut-outs, and integrated basins; complex curves are priced separately.

Pairing direction: Warm white pairs with light timber, soft wall colours, and rounded profiles for a less clinical interior.
